spec.title: 005f: Console Redesign Build Plan (ordered slices for an implementing model)

summary.text: Eleven slices that implement the decided design of `005e` §§5-11: first run and attention cards, palette and capabilities, header/footer/badges/help, chat soft-fill blocks, the activity ticker, one command set, daemon data for the narrator, narrator chrome, the epic rail and council weave, the remaining narrator views, and a real-terminal pass. Not in scope: the daemon protocol beyond slice 7, the approval semantics, the badge and mascot invariants of `005a`, Windows, the chromeless viewer.
